input.command:
cat > /tmp/odmedia.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
out=$("$OD_NODE_BIN" "$OD_BIN" media generate --project "$OD_PROJECT_ID" --surface image --model "$1" --aspect "$2" --prompt "$3")
last=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -1)
task_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$last" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('taskId',''))" 2>/dev/null)
since=$(printf '%s\n' "$last" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('nextSince',0))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$task_id" ]; then echo "NO TASK: $out"; exit 1; fi
while [ -n "$task_id" ]; do
  out=$("$OD_NODE_BIN" "$OD_BIN" media wait "$task_id" --since "${since:-0}" 2>&1)
  ec=$?
  last=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -1)
  since=$(printf '%s\n' "$last" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('nextSince',0))" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$ec" -eq 0 ]; then task_id=""; elif [ "$ec" -ne 2 ]; then echo "WAIT ERR $ec: $out" >&2; exit "$ec"; fi
done
printf '%s\n' "$last"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/odmedia.sh
echo done
